hypothesis: H98: explicit action-specific denominators expose missing REMOVE/ADD coverage and distinguish false NO-OP, wrong action, and abstention; exact-label agreement alone is insufficient.
matrix_orientation: reference rows, observed columns; fixed five labels

definitions.false_modification: reference!=MODIFY and predicted MODIFY; report both /all predicted MODIFY and /all non-MODIFY references
definitions.unsafe_removal: reference!=REMOVE and predicted REMOVE; report both /all predicted REMOVE and /all non-REMOVE references
definitions.change_wrong_or_abstained: reference in change labels and predicted!=reference / all change references; not equivalent to false NO-OP
definitions.missed_change_false_noop: reference in change labels and predicted NO-OP / all change references
definitions.change_abstention: reference in change labels and predicted INCONCLUSIVE / all change references
definitions.reference_abstention_recalled: reference INCONCLUSIVE and predicted INCONCLUSIVE / all reference INCONCLUSIVE
definitions.definitive_reference_abstention: reference!=INCONCLUSIVE and predicted INCONCLUSIVE / all definitive references
definitions.ADD_REMOVE_coverage: reference and predicted counts for ADD/REMOVE separately; zero reference means untested, not correct zero rate

causal_limit: Derived metrics inherit original version, exposed/trust/admission caveats; do not convert raw oracle agreement into semantic accuracy.
